name: SPIFFE / SPIRE
description: CNCF-graduated workload identity standard and its reference implementation.
descriptionZh: CNCF 毕业级工作负载身份标准及其参考实现。
keyFact: SPIFFE is the CNCF Graduated specification (graduated 23 August 2022) for cryptographic workload identity and SPIRE is its reference implementation; together they issue X.509-SVID and JWT-SVID credentials through a Workload API without pre-shared secrets, using node and workload attestation.
keyFactZh: SPIFFE 是 CNCF 毕业级（2022 年 8 月 23 日毕业）的加密工作负载身份规范，SPIRE 是其参考实现；二者通过 Workload API 签发 X.509-SVID 与 JWT-SVID 凭据，无需预共享密钥，依赖节点与工作负载 attestation。
